instructions.start: This is a list of things different people might say about themselves. We are interested in how you would describe yourself. There are no right or wrong answers. So you can describe yourself as honestly as possible, we will keep your responses confidential. We'd like you to take your time and read each statement carefully, selecting the response that best describes you.

items.name: pid5bf_01
items.text: People would describe me as reckless

items.name: pid5bf_02
items.text: I feel like I act totally on impulse

items.name: pid5bf_03
items.text: Even though I know better, I can't stop making rash decisions

items.name: pid5bf_04
items.text: I often feel like nothing I do really matters

items.name: pid5bf_05
items.text: Others see me as irresponsible

items.name: pid5bf_06
items.text: I'm not good at planning ahead

items.name: pid5bf_07
items.text: My thoughts often don't make sense to others

items.name: pid5bf_08
items.text: I worry about almost everything

items.name: pid5bf_09
items.text: I get emotional easily, often for very little reason

items.name: pid5bf_10
items.text: I fear being alone in life more than anything else

items.name: pid5bf_11
items.text: I get stuck on one way of doing things, even when it's clear it won't work

items.name: pid5bf_12
items.text: I have seen things that weren't really there

items.name: pid5bf_13
items.text: I steer clear of romantic relationships

items.name: pid5bf_14
items.text: I'm not interested in making friends

items.name: pid5bf_15
items.text: I get irritated easily by all sorts of things

items.name: pid5bf_16
items.text: I don't like to get too close to people

items.name: pid5bf_17
items.text: It's no big deal if I hurt other peoples' feelings

items.name: pid5bf_18
items.text: I rarely get enthusiastic about anything

items.name: pid5bf_19
items.text: I crave attention

items.name: pid5bf_20
items.text: I often have to deal with people who are less important than me

items.name: pid5bf_21
items.text: I often have thoughts that make sense to me but that other people say are strange

items.name: pid5bf_22
items.text: I use people to get what I want

items.name: pid5bf_23
items.text: I often "zone out" and then suddenly come to and realize that a lot of time has passed

items.name: pid5bf_24
items.text: Things around me often feel unreal, or more real than usual

items.name: pid5bf_25
items.text: It is easy for me to take advantage of others
